excluded.critique: runs the design critic as a forked subagent in a fresh context, which is a Claude Code mechanism
excluded.observe: reports what the Claude Code hooks recorded; nothing else records those events
excluded.scaffold-project: scaffolds the Claude Code project layout: a CLAUDE.md brief, .claude/settings.json and .claude/rules

hooks.reason: Codex does not run the Claude Code hooks: they read the Claude Code event shapes (Write|Edit tool names, its stop-hook protocol) and write a ledger only the Claude Code skills read. The plugin therefore declares an empty hooks object, so hooks/hooks.json at the plugin root is not loaded.

mcp.pathsMustBeAbsolute: The server runs with the plugin root as its working directory, so a relative path would be read against the plugin, not the project. It refuses relative paths and measures nothing.

browserGates: Gates that open a browser need playwright, which the plugin does not install. They report the browser as missing and fail; a missing browser is never a pass.
